about: Oxygen (O₂) makes up about 21% of air and strongly supports combustion, which is why industrial oxygen is the working gas for flame cutting, brazing and welding when combined with a fuel gas such as dissolved acetylene or LPG. It is also used in steel making, glass melting and water treatment.

Oxygen is an oxidiser: keep regulators, valves and fittings free of oil and grease, store cylinders upright and away from fuel gases, and never use oxygen to dust off clothing or equipment. Industrial oxygen is not a substitute for medical oxygen.
